Discount's 447A feed (lastUpdatedAt 2026-10-26T10:04) prints 0.169 (Leumi prints two decimals; the difference is rounding of the same report). Whether the figure includes the trustee fee is not stated (read as the manager's fee only). The manager's mutual-funds page (https://www.analyst.co.il/mutual-funds/, read 2026-10-26) has no fund table and prints no fund's fee. Exempt tax track: TXS-24 (Maya's export of 2026-10-22 lists two taxable money-market funds, named in TXS-26: 5103403 and 5137559); this fund is not one of them (its presence in the export was not re-checked). Discount's feed field 'TaxStatusAsMeta' (not displayed on the page) also reads 'פטורה'.
